subject: add -fno-omit-frame-pointer to default complication flags (#12973)
reason: The change only adds -fno-omit-frame-pointer to the default compiler flags in src/Makefile (a build/CI change). It affects code generation for debuggability and profiling (keeping the frame pointer register) but introduces no behavioral, protocol, replication, persistence, or data-path difference that a scenario could observe; any oracle comparison between the two builds would see identical behavior by design.
